rates.name: Rates
rates.read: An inverted curve — short rates above long — has preceded most modern recessions.

source.publisher: U.S. Treasury via Federal Reserve Board

volatility.name: Volatility
volatility.read: The option market's 30-day fear gauge. Spikes mark panic; calm can mark complacency.

source.metric: VIX, monthly mean of daily closes

credit.name: Credit & Funding
credit.read: 105 indicators of lending, funding, and risk appetite in one Fed index. The bridge sensor for methodology v3.

source.metric: National Financial Conditions Index, monthly mean

energy.name: Energy
energy.read: Expensive oil squeezes everything that moves. The upstream cousin of the gas-price line.

dollar.name: Dollar
dollar.read: A surging dollar means global funding stress and pressure on everyone who borrowed in it.

breadth.name: Breadth
breadth.read: How many of the eleven Sector Watch tickers are weakening. One bleeding sector moves this; a broad selloff maxes it.

source.metric: Weakness share: half-weight softening + full-weight stressed over 11 tickers
